name: Trust St Lsp
description: IEC 61131-3 Structured Text language server for Claude Code. Wires the trust-lsp binary into Claude Code's LSP integration for diagnostics, go-to-definition, find references, hover, document and workspace symbols, and call hierarchy on .st files.
longDescription:
Installs with `claude plugin install trust-st-lsp@claude-community` from `johannesPettersson80/trust-claude-plugins` (`plugins/trust-st-lsp`).

IEC 61131-3 Structured Text language server for Claude Code. Wires the `trust-lsp` binary into Claude Code's built-in LSP plugin integration so the agent gets diagnostics, navigation, hover, symbols, and call hierarchy on `.st` files.
